name: The Wanking Dead
source:
You play as a man who has just woken up from a coma, to find that the world is completely different to what he remembers. He will be challenged with different choices which will have consequences to other survivors. Can he be the leader this new world desperately needs?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/EHFaR]Patreon[/url]]
